messages:
marta: Headline: a few tenants reported invoice preview lower than ledger after quota-hedge rollout. preview shows hedged tokens applied only after final join, ledger has raw+hedge adjustments later. confusing for support
owen: I think this is the late-join problem we've danced around. hedges are computed by the quota service and emitted to the billing sideband, but that service writes its adjustments asynchronously and the aggregator rollup happens earlier, so preview (which samples early) doesn't see hedges
nina: preview pipeline samples before the hedges arrive. ledger ingestion accepts hedge deltas later and preserves them. So previews undercount until the final reconcile runs. Customers see preview -> ledger mismatch and open tickets
tyler: short-term mitigation: mark previews as "provisional" for windows that still have pending hedges. we can add an attribution_confidence flag based on whether hedge offsets exist for the time window in the hedges index
marta: I like provisional badge. UX: label invoice preview "provisional - hedges pending" with small tooltip and ETA for finalization. reduces support noise
owen: longer term, we should either 1) emit hedges synchronously in the hot path (expensive) or 2) materialize a light-weight hedge hint earlier in pipeline: emit a provisional_hedge_event at time of quota decision so preview can include it and mark it provisional, final hedge can reconcile later
nina: option 2 seems pragmatic. hedge_hint payload would be small: tenant_id, window_id, hedge_tokens, hint_id. aggregator can include hint into rollups but keep a tombstone when final comes through to avoid double counting
tyler: implementation concerns: need idempotency for hints and tombstones. recommend hint_id = sha256(tenant_id + window_id + policy_version). dedupe window = rollup window + 30s cushion
sam: sampling impact: preview currently samples raw events pre-aggregation. we'll need preview sampler to include hedge_hints or run sampling after rollup. cheaper to include hint in the sampled stream (add a small enrichment in sampler to lookup hint index)
owen: ops checklist draft: 1) add provisional badge in console (marta) 2) emit hedge_hint from quota service (owen) 3) aggregator change to merge hint into rollup and emit tombstone on final hedge (nina) 4) preview sampler tweak to include hedge_hint (sam) 5) backfill detection job to find windows with mismatches
marta: canary plan: small cohort of 25 tenants across orgs, enable hints for them only and show provisional badge. monitor preview_vs_ledger_delta and support tickets for cohort. start 02:00 UTC tomorrow for 3h window
ops-bot: Ticket MET-6001 created by marta: "billing: add provisional hedge hints to reduce preview/ledger mismatch during quota-hedge async writes". priority P2. owners: owen (hedge_hint), nina (aggregator merge), sam (preview), marta (console). Canar y scheduled 02:00 UTC tomorrow
owen: quick pseudo for hint emit:
```
hint = {
  "tenant_id": tid,
  "window_id": window_key, 
  "hedge_tokens": hedge_amount, 
  "hint_id": sha256(tid+window_key+policy_v)
}
emit_to_metering_hint(hint)
```
nina: aggregator merge idea: when rollup sees a hint, add provisional_hedge field to rollup row. when final hedge delta arrives, apply it and set provisional_hedge = null, emit tombstone event so console can show adjustment line in final invoice
tyler: add metrics: hedge_hint_ingest_rate, provisional_vs_final_delta, hint_dedupe_count. alert if provisional delta diverges >1% at 30m window
marta: I'll mock the UI and stipend copy for the provisional badge, plus runbook text for support to explain provisional vs final. good to have that in the ticket
ops-bot: MET-6001 updated: owners and canary noted. Reminder scheduled for MET-6001 canary at 02:00 UTC tomorrow
